audience.public_segment: Academic staff, HR administrators, department heads and performance coordinators
audience.internal_buyer_unit: Executive HR/HR Director; Performance Management; HR Business Partners; Organisational Development

hypothesis: If Institute of People Management (IPM) is shown 'Fake staff annual-review case: agreement + approved Outlook/file evidence -> KPA/task mapping -> gaps -> human-reviewed performance snapshot.', then the HR/performance-management decision-maker is more likely to request a bounded pilot because the offer addresses a specific workflow pain without surrendering human authority.

experiment.channel: Verify current role inbox/form; use proof-led partnership/pilot approach
experiment.proof_summary: A controlled private proof mapped 190 evidence records to performance objectives, retained review candidates and exposed evidence gaps without making a rating decision.
experiment.public_hook: Performance review panic starts when evidence was never collected as evidence.
experiment.cta: Request one task-agreement and evidence snapshot pilot.
experiment.kill_condition: No qualified engagement after two permission-safe attempts or channel test; re-evaluate message/fit before any further approach.

gates.reason: Research and proof-content generation are allowed; no valid electronic sales permission is recorded.
